findings.claim: Enrollment conflates the authenticated responsible issuer with operational recipient agents, rejects a valid agency-admin without agent_id and does not compare reservation.agent_id.
findings.fix: Separate enrollment responsibility from grant recipients and validate persisted tenant, agency, device and reservation ownership bindings.

findings.claim: Download does not compare package.manifest_digest with grant.manifest_digest and can return an internally consistent package bound to a different grant digest.
findings.fix: Compare persisted package and grant digests and return the contracted 410 on divergence.

findings.claim: Renewal checks only grants[0], allowing a newer active grant to hide an older terminal unreconciled obligation.
findings.fix: Require reconciliation of every terminal obligation or an explicit replacement relation that cannot discard an earlier obligation.

notes: Independent read-only review; no Git, installation, edits, sibling access or database mutation.
The five cycle-2 findings were materially corrected, but the three residual high findings remain blocking.
RLS, FORCE RLS, append-only privileges, deny-all generated CRUD, idempotency, outbox, 428/412, revoke 200 and typed contracts were independently rechecked.
